# polaris_principal_role (Resource)

Manages an Apache Polaris principal role for RBAC assignment to principals.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_principal_role" "data_engineers" {
  name = "data_engineers_role"

  properties = {
    description = "Role for data engineering members"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the principal role.

### Optional

- `federated` (Boolean) Whether the role is managed by an external identity provider.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom properties associated with this principal role.

### Read-Only

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Current entity version counter for optimistic concurrency.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
